headline: Trump: cut rates or I stop trading

beats.text: September fourth. A blockbuster jobs report drops, and within minutes Trump's already threatening to blow up trade over an interest rate.

beats.caption: Lower the rate or I'll stop trading with countries with which we have a trade deficit
beats.label: via CNN

beats.text: Not adjusted tariffs. Not a renegotiated deal. Full stop, over one interest rate.

beats.caption: We have the right to stop doing business with them
beats.label: via Forbes Breaking News

beats.text: And just so nobody misses the point, the President spells out exactly where that road ends.

beats.caption: They would go from a so-called elite country to a poverty-stricken country
beats.label: via Forbes Breaking News

beats.text: Economists were, naturally, thrilled to hear the President's plan for the global trading system.

beats.caption: It will make the Great Depression ... look like a walk in the park
beats.label: via MS NOW

beats.text: Somewhere, an economics professor is quietly weeping into a chart.
